Pre-alloyed powders with a nominal composition of Cu – 1wt.%Y were prepared by gas atomization in an Ar atmosphere.
Mix the above raw materials in a specific ratio and prepare them by mechanical alloying according to the previous method [ 28 ], we used a shortened mechanical alloying time (30h).
Initially, the powder was heated to 600 ◦ C at 50 ◦ C/min and held at 600 ◦ C for 5 min under 30 MPa to facilitate the removal of gaseous impurities.
Subsequently, the temperature was raised to 900 ◦ C at 100 ◦ C/min and maintained for 5 min, while the pressure was increased from 30 MPa to 60 MPa to promote particle rearrangement.
The consolidated specimens were then thermally treated (600 ◦ C/1-100 h) under argon shielding after sintering.
